questions.question: Your CV lists Git among your tools; could you describe one project where you used it, such as how you branched, reviewed or released changes, and which role it was in?
Your CV lists pandas among your Python tools; can you give one example of a data task you did with it, roughly how large the data was, and in which role?
Your CV lists statistics as a skill; could you describe one analysis where you applied a statistical method, such as the method, the question it answered and the role you were in?
Your CV mentions AWS (S3, SageMaker) but your listed roles don't show where it was used; can you describe one project where you used these, what you did with them and roughly when?
You mentioned using Looker daily for two years before Nordlys Retail moved to Tableau; can you give one example of a dashboard or analysis you built in it and which role and period that was?

You said you deployed two model services on a client's Kubernetes cluster with their platform team's help; could you walk through one of those deployments, including what you handled yourself and when it was?
Your CV shows an online deep learning course; have you applied deep learning in a project, at work or personally? If so, could you describe one example, the problem, the model and the scale?
Your CV mentions an online course in PyTorch; is there a model you built or trained with it beyond the course, and if so what was it, what data size did you use and when did you do it?
